title: Cell membrane
abstract: The cell membrane controls transport between the cell and its environment.

title: Mitochondria
abstract: Mitochondria produce ATP through cellular respiration and support cellular energy needs.

title: Enzymes
abstract: Enzymes accelerate biochemical reactions and lower activation energy.

title: Antibodies
abstract: Antibodies bind specific antigens and contribute to immune recognition.

title: Vaccines
abstract: Vaccines stimulate immune memory and can reduce the risk of severe infectious disease.

title: Clinical trials
abstract: Clinical trials evaluate the safety and efficacy of interventions in defined participant groups.

title: Randomisation
abstract: Randomisation reduces allocation bias and supports balanced comparison between study groups.

title: Peer review
abstract: Peer review evaluates methods and evidence before a research article is accepted for publication.

title: Sample size
abstract: Sample size affects statistical power and the precision of estimated effects.

title: Antibiotic resistance
abstract: Antibiotic resistance can reduce treatment effectiveness and requires appropriate antimicrobial stewardship.

title: Data sharing
abstract: Data sharing supports replication when privacy and consent requirements are respected.

title: Diagnostic tests
abstract: Diagnostic tests estimate the likelihood of a condition and must be interpreted with clinical context.
